title: Grim Knight
description: A kneeling knight in fractured armor guards a ruined cathedral, surrounded by ravens, torn banners, thorn vines and shattered stone. This full-back Gothic design is paired with its clean outline, placement mockup, reference board, lore card and style guide.
outline_standard: Clean black line art on white, prepared as a tattoo reference outline. Have a licensed tattoo artist review and adapt sizing and transfer setup before use.
